author: Brett Minkin
text: I think some kind of patch is vital. Some last a little longer than others, and some are more irritating to the skin for some people, but as long as you get one that doesn’t have any adhesive in the center, where it covers the sensor, it doesn’t really matter which one you choose. Just try one, and see how you like it. Without one, it’s fairly easy for the sensor to get caught on something, and get pulled off.
